args.query: SanitizeInstance

questions.why: Impact closure across handlers. SanitizeInstance's direct dependents span packages: chunkInstance lives in handler/doc/entities.go, newAuthorEntity in handler/git/entities.go, and no single file carries both names (check-composition.py-verified, tests included). Answering requires the reverse-dependency edge set — a caller from BOTH files must be NAMED — not one lucky chunk. Cap math: 7 production + 5 test callers = 12 distinct dependents, exactly at code_impact's 12-per-role naming cap; a new caller added anywhere silently pushes a name off the list, so re-verify fan-in when this question changes verdict.

args.query: PublishLifecycleTrigger

questions.why: Impact closure across processors. PublishLifecycleTrigger (graph/lifecycle.go) is called by triggerRemovalLifecycleRun in processor/source-manifest/ingest.go and triggerLifecycleRun in processor/ast-source and processor/doc-source; the two names never share a file, and neither is a substring of the other (the grader's substring matcher cannot satisfy one from the other). 5 production + 2 test callers — comfortably inside the naming cap. The safest question in the band: if this one misses, the caller-edge traversal itself is broken.

args.query: ScopedSystemSlug

questions.why: Impact closure across the ingest and lifecycle planes. ScopedSystemSlug (entityid/entityid.go) is called from initializeWatchers in processor/ast-source/component.go and systemsForComponentConfig in processor/source-manifest/lifecycle_scope.go — the entity-identity helper joining two subsystems that share no file. ~9 distinct callers including tests, inside the cap.

args.query: URLToSlug

questions.why: Impact closure across config expansion and the git handler. URLToSlug (workspace/workspace.go) is called by expandMultiBranch in config/expand.go and systemSlug in handler/git/handler.go; the names never co-occur (systemSlug also exists in handler/cfgfile, still never beside expandMultiBranch). 3 production + 2 test callers. NOTE the band is impact-closure-only, and that is the finding, not an oversight: version composition needs two ingested versions (the archive corpus has no .git, so no version entities), a cross-source join is unanswerable in one call because graph_search's default (ranked compact) response carries no property values like ConfigDepVersion — gateway rendering for the full-entity shape is shipped but its default-path enablement is blocked on semstreams#958, and a caller+callee relation join requires three-file separation this codebase's layout (helpers beside callers) does not produce — callee-pair facts are inadmissible BY CONSTRUCTION since a body co-locates every callee it names. See README.
